spots.name: A Journey toward Freedom & Excellence
spots.blurb: You've reached A Journey toward Freedom & Excellence, a mural by Corey Pane. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.

spots.name: Graffiti Arches
spots.blurb: You've reached Graffiti Arches, a graffiti piece. Concrete arches. A space designated by the town for residents to paint.
